COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a woven basket of berries in the crook of her arm; it is all she holds.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE WOMAN ONLY, with exactly one Pokémon companion as the scene describes — a separate creature at its own natural scale, its body never merged with hers, not a second human and not dressed like her.
